metadata.description: Browser-sampled migration probability grids for the Ngulia home-page deck.gl prototype.
metadata.normalization: Each values array sums to one and can be sampled as a discrete probability distribution.
metadata.source: Departure densities are smoothed from recoveries north of Ngulia; landing densities are smoothed from recoveries south of Ngulia.
metadata.landMask: Coarse in-script land polygons with broad water holes for rapid prototype iteration.
